name: Potluck
author: Rob Newton
description: Potluck local-AI in the Omarchy bar and a summoned overlay: sidecar health, the loaded model and the device it runs on, streamed answers, a model manager (load, unload, download), app open/close, and a usage view.

barWidget.description: One bar pill: whether the Potluck sidecar is running, which model is loaded and on what device, and how much RAM is left. Left-click opens the Ask overlay; right-click launches or focuses the app.

schema.label: Sidecar URL
schema.description: The Potluck local sidecar. Stays on loopback; nothing is sent off the machine.

schema.label: Show the model name in the bar
schema.description: Off shows just the status dot, which suits a vertical bar.

schema.label: App command
schema.description: Run on right-click, and on left-click when the click action below is set to launch the app.

schema.label: Left-click action
schema.description: Right-click always runs the app command and middle-click always refreshes, whichever this is set to.
